title: Hybrid Preferences: Learning to Route Instances for Human vs. AI Feedback
authors_zh: Lester James V. Miranda、Yizhong Wang、Yanai Elazar、Sachin Kumar、Valentina Pyatkin、Faeze Brahman、Noah A. Smith、Hannaneh Hajishirzi、Pradeep Dasigi
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈审计研究者
one_line: Hybrid Preferences releases MultiPref, where the same response comparisons carry crowdworker, expert, and language-model feedback for studying when human annotation is worth its additional cost.
Hybrid Preferences 发布 MultiPref：同一回答比较同时带有众包、专家和语言模型反馈，用于研究何时值得为人工标注付出额外成本。
why: MultiPref pairs the same response comparisons with crowdworker, expert, and LM annotations for feedback-routing research.
inclusion_reason: MultiPref pairs the same response comparisons with crowdworker, expert, and LM annotations for feedback-routing research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Collecting direct human preferences for open-ended assistants is expensive and slow, and annotators can still make mistakes on complex or unfamiliar comparisons. Replacing people with an LM reduces collection cost but can transfer the judge’s biases or miss judgments that people would make; selecting one source for every record can therefore waste a fixed human-label budget.

Hybrid Preferences introduces HyPER, which routes each prompt–response comparison to humans or an LM and produces a mixed-label preference set for reward-model training. The paper evaluates whether that source-allocation decision improves the resulting reward model, rather than asking which source defines preference universally.

直接为开放式助手收集人类偏好既昂贵又耗时，标注者面对复杂或陌生的比较仍可能判断失误。以语言模型替代人工虽能降低收集成本，却可能带入裁判偏差或遗漏人类会作出的判断；在全部记录上固定一种来源，因而可能浪费有限的人工标签预算。

Hybrid Preferences 提出 HyPER，将每个提示—回答比较路由给人工或语言模型，并产出供奖励模型训练的混合标签偏好集。论文评测这种来源分配是否改善最终奖励模型，而不是追问哪一种来源能够普遍定义偏好。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: HyPER predicts which allocation of human and LM labels will train the strongest downstream reward model, then routes each comparison to the selected source. Its feedback object is a prompt, two candidate answers, and matched source-specific preferences; MultiPref provides 10,461 English comparisons from 5,323 prompts, with human and GPT-4 judgments, overall/aspect judgments, and reasons. The resulting contract preserves who supplied the selected ordering, making the release useful for reward-model routing and audit rather than presenting either source as a universal preference ground truth.
HyPER 预测何种人工与语言模型标签分配可训练出最强的下游奖励模型，再将每条比较路由给选定来源。其反馈对象是一个提示、两个候选回答和匹配的来源特定偏好；MultiPref 提供 10,461 条英文比较，来自 5,323 个提示，并带有人工与 GPT-4 判断、总体／方面判断和理由。由此形成的契约保留被选排序由谁给出，使该发布可用于奖励模型路由和审计，而不把任一来源表述为普适偏好的真实答案。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build MultiPref from prompt–answer pairs that have both human and GPT-4 preference labels, then describe each pair with textual and instruction tags. 2. Sample human-label budgets and use the tags to assemble candidate mixtures: records inside the selected subset retain human labels, and the rest retain GPT-4 labels. 3. Train reward models on 200 such mixtures and use their RewardBench results to fit the quadratic performance prediction model. 4. For a target pool, score 500 simulated allocations with that model and retain the highest-scoring route; pairs tied by either source are excluded from reward-model training.

The input is a dual-labeled preference pool; the output is a routed label set for reward-model training. The acceptance signal is predicted RewardBench performance. Reproduction requires the MultiPref revision, tagging implementation, GPT versions, reward-model recipe, candidate-sampling seed, human budget, and RewardBench revision; serving cost for a new run is not fully disclosed.

1. 从同时具有人类和 GPT-4 偏好标签的提示—回答对构建 MultiPref，并以文本特征和指令描述为每对样本打标签。2. 抽样人工标签预算，按标签形成候选混合：被选子集保留人工标签，其余记录保留 GPT-4 标签。3. 在 200 个此类混合上训练奖励模型，并以 RewardBench 结果拟合二次性能预测模型。4. 面对目标样本池，用该模型为 500 个模拟分配评分，保留预测最高的路由；任一来源标为平局的回答对不进入奖励模型训练。

输入是双标签偏好样本池，输出是供奖励模型训练的路由标签集；接受信号是预测的 RewardBench 表现。复现需固定 MultiPref 版本、标签实现、GPT 版本、奖励模型配方、候选采样随机种子、人工预算和 RewardBench 版本；新运行的服务成本未完全披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: selecting label source by HyPER yields a more useful reward-model training set than using people only, GPT-4 only, or a random mixture under the same human budget. Controlled setup: the paper holds the reward-model objective and RewardBench evaluation fixed while changing the label-source allocation; the random baseline is budget-matched. Result: the HyPER-selected mixture improves RewardBench by 7–13% over either exclusive source and improves Best-of-N reranking by 2–3% (Section 4). Boundary: this comparison supports the released routing procedure on the tested preference datasets and base models; it cannot identify how much of the gain comes separately from tags, PPM fit, or candidate simulation.

主张：在相同人工预算下，HyPER 选择标签来源所形成的奖励模型训练集，比只用人工、只用 GPT-4 或随机混合更有用。受控设置：论文固定奖励模型目标和 RewardBench 评估，只改变标签来源分配；随机基线与方法组的人工预算匹配。结果：HyPER 选择的混合比任一单独来源在 RewardBench 上提高 7–13%，并使 Best-of-N 重排提高 2–3%（第 4 节）。边界：该比较支持已发布路由流程在所测偏好数据集和基础模型上的表现；不能分别确定标签、性能预测模型拟合或候选模拟各自贡献了多少增益。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest alternative chooses humans, an LM, or a random mixture at dataset level. HyPER changes the selection unit to an instance or feature group and optimizes it against predicted downstream reward-model performance. Using both feedback sources is not new; retaining matched labels in MultiPref makes the allocation decision inspectable.
最接近的替代做法是在数据集层面选择人工、语言模型或随机混合。HyPER 将选择单位改为单条实例或特征组，并针对预测的下游奖励模型表现优化。两种反馈来源并非新事物；MultiPref 保留匹配标签，使来源分配决策可审计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated limitation: the routing experiments beyond MultiPref remain at the same post-filtering size of about 7K records, so the PPM may not extrapolate when preference data continue to grow. The paper also finds only small differences when using the datasets or mixtures for DPO, and says that reward-model gains may not transfer to PPO or policy performance; before reuse, evaluate the routed data in the actual downstream objective rather than RewardBench alone.

Curator audit risk: reward-model training removes every pair tied by humans or GPT-4, retaining 7,531 non-tie records. This can concentrate learning on clearer cases and weaken claims about ambiguous comparisons; report the removed share and test the final reward model on a tie-rich slice.

作者明示的局限：除 MultiPref 外的路由实验仍保持约 7K 条过滤后记录的相同规模，因此偏好数据继续扩张时，性能预测模型能否外推尚不明确。论文还发现用这些数据集或混合训练 DPO 时差异很小，并指出奖励模型增益未必迁移到 PPO 或策略表现；复用前应在实际下游目标上评估路由数据，而不能只看 RewardBench。

策展审计风险：奖励模型训练删除所有被人工或 GPT-4 标为平局的回答对，仅保留 7,531 条非平局记录。这可能使学习集中于界限更清楚的案例，并削弱对模糊比较的主张；应报告删除比例，并在平局丰富的切片上测试最终奖励模型。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A reward-model team with a limited human-label budget can reuse HyPER when it has a seed pool judged by both people and an LM. Use the released tag features and fixed reward-model recipe to train a PPM, route the target pool, then compare the resulting model with all-human, all-LM, and budget-matched random mixtures on a held-out reward benchmark. The output is a budgeted labeling plan and a routed training set. Do not reuse the allocation unchanged across a new language, task, or judge without calibration.
人工标签预算有限、且拥有人工与语言模型双重判断种子集的奖励模型团队可复用 HyPER。应使用发布的标签特征和固定奖励模型配方训练性能预测模型，路由目标样本池，再在留出奖励基准上与全人工、全语言模型和预算匹配随机混合比较。输出是预算内标注计划和路由后的训练集。面对新的语言、任务或裁判时，未经校准不得原样复用分配。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. HyPER routes label source, not answer correctness.
  2. Tags define candidate human/LM mixtures; RewardBench trains the PPM.
  3. MultiPref has 10,461 comparisons; 7,531 non-tie records train reward models.
  4. The selected mix gains 7–13% on RewardBench, under the reported protocol.
  5. Reuse only with a dual-labeled seed set; first test PPM calibration and tie-rate shift.

1. HyPER 路由标签来源，不判定回答事实正确性。
  2. 标签形成候选人机混合，RewardBench 用于训练性能预测模型。
  3. MultiPref 有 10,461 条比较，奖励模型训练保留 7,531 条非平局记录。
  4. 所选混合在 RewardBench 上提高 7–13%，结论受报告协议限制。
  5. 仅在有双标签种子集时复用；先测试性能预测模型校准和平局率变化。
